answer: The price of cheating is written in the book before any cheat arrives, so no one can plead surprise. Joiner mortise record with joiners attestation is where the price is written: seven-year record, 2,000 joints cut, timber accounts, yearly fees. Cheat with a counterfeit harbor and the price is exacted at once, twice the value of the goods plus the basalt as a fine, while the reef is recorded in the book and read when the year turns.
